pr_title: EQL: cover head/tail commands edge cases and data types coverage
pr_comments: Hi @astefan, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: EQL: Head and tail fail to gracefully deal with invalid values
issue_context.body:
### Description

A query like `any where true | head 2147483648` fails with `class java.lang.Long cannot be cast to class java.lang.Integer (java.lang.Long and java.lang.Integer are in module java.base of loader 'bootstrap')`.

While one like `any where true | head 2147483640 + 8` fails with `"type": "arithmetic_exception", "reason": "integer overflow"`.

review_comments: super-duper nit: could replace the `1L` by a random value.
